title: ConformanceRecord
description: A recorded report/2 run against an exact count-stage or ordinary suite.

artifact.description: The artifact the record is evidence for.

suite_version.description: The suite's `provenance.suite_version`, equal to the report's `suite.version`; written into the record's source as `suite.version` (planning.rs `recorded_from_report`).

suite_kind.description: `count_stage` or `ordinary`: the two kinds this admission records.

producer_profile.description: The report's profile, written into the record's source as `producer_profile` exactly as the report spells it (ess_conformance_v2.rs `facts`).

execution_status.description: The report's `execution_status`, once the outcomes above have agreed with it.

completed_at.description: The report's own `completed_at`, never this process's clock.

report_input.description: The report, named as aep.evidence.InputForm `repository_relative` or `file_name`; written into the record's source as `report_input`.

report_input_digest.description: The report's digest, written into the record's source as `report_input_digest`.

suite_input.description: The suite, named the same way; written into the record's source as `suite_input`.

suite_input_digest.description: The suite's digest, written into the record's source as `suite_input_digest`.

reference.description: The record's `reference` when `--ref` gives none: `report_input`, `@`, and `report_input_digest`, e.g. `reports/run.json@sha256:<64 hex>`. A `--ref` is the caller's words and is written as given.
